name: Hercegszántó (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a yellow band into a blue upper fly part and a red lower hoist part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hercegszántó: a crowned blue shield with a yellow figure of the Virgin between crosses.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
